_notes: Partial Stage 6 draft written by UX Designer UX-006-03 at 2026-10-03T07:48:17Z (UTC from code). It is not a complete export set, has not been reviewed and is not approved. Stage 8 is not approved.

The only real screen exports are wireframes/list-desktop.html and wireframes/list-desktop.png, byte-identical to code.html and screen.png in the official Stitch export ZIP (SHA-256 2f2d331d92405628ec56c97092d5e954f7ae5894dad003764bdb109d9604538d). The HTML is also byte-identical to the get_screen HTML of screen 571fa1a5dfa6478c8712368474cc5d03.

The iteration-page screen claims only what list-desktop shows: rows 92, 95 and 97. Rows 91, 93, 96, 98, 99, 101-104 and 210 of iteration-page are planned in the normalization but not drawn, so they are not claimed here.

Pending, not exported: list-phone (screen 67531e08b55c4c3988225e51a46e51e9 was generated; its pre-edit export breaks the foundation and the corrective edit result could not be obtained); form-desktop, form-phone, dialog-desktop and dialog-phone (not generated). The other 24 planned screens of the normalization are not drawn.
No component sheet (wireframes/ui-kit.html) is exported, so ui_design_system.resources is empty and catalogue previews do not resolve. No resource is invented.
Roles: only the editor view is drawn; the viewer variation follows the SDD permission matrix (D-001) and is not drawn.

Sample defect, not retouched: the list-desktop header shows Estimated 120.0 h, Remaining 72.0 h and Progress 40%, but the five rows sum to 100.0 h, 52.0 h and 48%. Story 1 shows Accepted with 8.0 h remaining.
Deferred (31) and pending (5) rows are listed in the normalization _notes. The schema has no field for them (process backlog item 12).
